description: This file defines a configuration class for interacting with RunwayML's image generation API, including methods for URL construction, environment validation, response transformation, task polling (both sync and async), and request/response handling specific to RunwayML's API. It extends a base image transformation configuration and includes detailed logic for response polling and format transformation.

classes.name: RunwayMLImageGenerationConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for RunwayML image generation, managing URL construction, environment validation, response transformation, and polling for task completion.

methods.name: str get_complete_url( self, api_base: Optional[str], api_key: Optional[str], model: str, optional_params: dict, litellm_params: dict, stream: Optional[bool] = None, )

methods.name: dict validate_environment( self, headers: dict, model: str, messages: List[AllMessageValues], optional_params: dict, litellm_params: dict, api_key: Optional[str] = None, api_base: Optional[str] = None, )
methods.description: Validates and sets necessary headers based on available API keys.

methods.description: Converts RunwayML's response format into the OpenAI ImageResponse format.

methods.description: Checks if the polling operation has timed out.

methods.name: str _check_task_status(response_data: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Checks and normalizes the status of a RunwayML task from its response.

methods.description: Synchronously polls a RunwayML task until it completes or times out.

methods.description: Asynchronously polls a RunwayML task until completion.
